terra.problem: “Nobody stops to ask what God wants” overlooks the spies’ request that the priest inquire of God about their journey (18:5). The distinction is that they asked about success, not whether their actions honored God.
“God’s house was RIGHT THERE” and “down the road” misleadingly suggest that Shiloh was close to Dan. The passage says the house of God was in Shiloh, not that it was nearby.
